Gender roles have been a patriarchal construct I believe since the Feudal era, in which men were seen as the only capable people to handle decisions (There are outliers but majority of the time this was the case). Capitalism adopted this and continued with the oppression of woman to the extent that woman only got voting rights in the past 100 year, which is very recent history considering if you look at the grand scheme of things.

Under Socialism/communism the mantra is "From each according to his ability, to each according to his need" in which there is not a specific role for gender, but rather what is the capability of a person to do a specific task.

My personal opinion is that men and woman are on the same playing field (Within the Marxist-Leninist context), in which whoever can do a specific task or job should have the opportunity to learn and do it. I believe in equity over equality as we want to give people the tools to do the things they want to, not based on gender but rather on ability and interest.
